root_causes_fixed_this_session.title: Circle rendering: 3/4 Bezier arcs degenerate to straight lines
root_causes_fixed_this_session.root_cause: dxf_geometry_indexer_v2._circle_length() correctly reads entity.dxf.radius and entity.dxf.center from DXF, but discards them — only stores 36-point discretized polygon. _dxf_adapter._build_vcf_spec() labels geom_type='Circle' but passes 36-point polygon. _writer._compute_circle_params() back-computes cx/cy/radius from bounding box with floating point error → 3 of 4 Bezier arcs degenerate.
root_causes_fixed_this_session.fix: 3-file change: (1) indexer stores circle_cx/cy/radius in entity dict for CIRCLE. (2) adapter passes circle_params in element dict (with coord transform). (3) writer checks _path_circle_params, uses direct cx/cy/radius when available, falls back to _compute_circle_params() only when None.
root_causes_fixed_this_session.verification: circle_ph4.VCF = 157876B (same as native). Geometry header matches native byte-for-byte.

root_causes_fixed_this_session.title: ACI 0 vs 7 color collision — both mapped to (0,0,0)
root_causes_fixed_this_session.root_cause: ACI_TO_RGB[0] and ACI_TO_RGB[7] both (0,0,0). geom_color = 0x00000000 for both layers. Reader matches geom_color against layer block colors, so same geom_color = only first layer found.
root_causes_fixed_this_session.fix: ACI_TO_RGB[0] changed to (10, 10, 10) — visually identical black but unique geom_color.

root_causes_fixed_this_session.title: ByLayer (color=256) unresolved — always mapped to ACI 7
root_causes_fixed_this_session.root_cause: dxf_geometry_indexer_v2.py line 1395: if color_idx == 256: color_idx = 7. layer_colors dict (built at line 1388) was NEVER USED.
root_causes_fixed_this_session.fix: if color_idx == 256: color_idx = layer_colors.get(entity.dxf.layer, 7) — now resolves to actual layer color.

root_causes_fixed_this_session.title: Trailer prefix: 200B TRAILER_PREFIX causes Ruida errors
root_causes_fixed_this_session.root_cause: Original writer appended 200B TRAILER_PREFIX (float64 5.0 and 90.0) before path data. Native files have NO such prefix. ph3 tried 4B zeros — still wrong. ph4: 20B zeros matches native.
root_causes_fixed_this_session.verification: Confirmed against ALL native files (1ks, fishbone, manchester, botanic, circle, square).

root_causes_fixed_this_session.title: Last element gets 196B FOOTER not 180B TAIL
root_causes_fixed_this_session.root_cause: All 4 native multi-element files show exactly 180 bytes after last element before trailer. Inter-element gaps are 196B. Writer was writing 196B footer for ALL elements including last.
root_causes_fixed_this_session.fix: ELEMENT_TAIL = ELEMENT_FOOTER[:-16] (180B). body() tracks total_elements count, writes ELEMENT_TAIL for last element only.
root_causes_fixed_this_session.verification: Confirmed against ALL native multi-element files (1ks=6elem, fishbone=14elem, manchester=3elem, botanic=16elem).

critical_discoveries.title: b2b reader != VCutWorks rendering engine
critical_discoveries.description: První funkční VCF (commit 4ba9446) měl 0 layers dle b2b readeru (geom_color mismatch), přesto se v GUI vykreslil. VCutWorks používá vlastní parser s odlišnou logikou.

critical_discoveries.title: Native header je vždy 472 B (machine profile)
critical_discoveries.description: Všechny native VCF s obsahem sdílejí identický 472B header (54B preamble + 418B machine profile) bez ohledu na geometrii.

critical_discoveries.title: TRAILER PREFIX: 20B zeros (not 200B, not 4B)
critical_discoveries.description: Native files have 20 zero bytes before path data in trailer. Original writer had 200B TRAILER_PREFIX (float64 5.0+90.0). ph3 had 4B zeros. Both caused Ruida errors.

critical_discoveries.title: LAST ELEMENT TAIL: 180B (not 196B footer)
critical_discoveries.description: Confirmed across ALL 4 native multi-element files: inter-element gaps = 196B, last-element gap = 180B (= footer - 16B).

critical_discoveries.title: Circle needs cx/cy/radius pass-through, not recomputation
critical_discoveries.description: DXF indexer discards circle center/radius. Writer recomputes from 36-point polygon → floating point errors → 3/4 arcs degenerate. Fix: pass cx/cy/radius through pipeline.

critical_discoveries.title: ACI 0 ≠ ACI 7 — unique geom_color required
critical_discoveries.description: Both mapped to (0,0,0) → geom_color collision → reader cannot distinguish layers. Fix: ACI 0 → (10,10,10).

critical_discoveries.title: ByLayer (256) must resolve to actual layer color
critical_discoveries.description: Hardcoded to ACI 7. layer_colors dict was built but never used. Fix: resolve via layer_colors.get().

post_session_addendum_2026_06_30.note: Tento addendum byl přidán 2026-06-30 po session 8. Dokumentuje multi-iterační debugging journey a B2B parser breakthrough, který odhalil správný význam ec@92 a offset606.
debugging_journey_summary: Session 7 skončila s 28/28 testy, ale multi-element VCF se v GUI stále zobrazoval jako 1 element.
Iterace 8.1: Analýza off-by-2 chyby v preamble — POST_STOCK_HEADER je 14B (4+8+2), ne 12B. To zneplatnilo dřívější závěr o ec@92=0.
Iterace 8.2: Ruční hex diff všech native VCF (1-elem i 2-elem) — ec@92=1 vždy. ec@92 je 'has geometry' flag, ne element count.

Iterace 8.3: Průzkum produkčního parseru vcf_parser_b2b (repo: C:\Users\PC\Documents\Repozitar_Dev\_github\vcf_parser_b2b\src\). Parser používá GEOMETRY_SIG (bytes 444-449: b'\x89G\x00\x10\x00\x00') forward scan + backward layer block scan.
Iterace 8.4: B2B parser nečte ec@92 ani offset606! Pouze skenuje binární strukturu. Proto parser vždy našel 2 elementy i v synth VCF před fixem — ale GUI používalo offset606 a zobrazovalo jen 1.
BREAKTHROUGH: Poslední 4B posledního layer bloku (offset606) = celkový počet elementů. V nativních souborech: 1-elem→1, 2-elem→2. Writer psal vždy 1.
FIX: ec@92=1 (line 275), offset606=total_elements (line 183). Obě jednoduché změny, ale trvalo 8 iterací je najít.

critical_discoveries_addendum.title: Off-by-2 bug v preamble výpočtu
critical_discoveries_addendum.description: POST_STOCK_HEADER = pack('<I',0)+pack('<d',100.0)+pack('<H',1) = 14B. Dříve používáno 12B. To posunulo celou layer block analýzu o 2B.

critical_discoveries_addendum.title: offset606 = element count v posledním layer bloku
critical_discoveries_addendum.description: Poslední 4B posledního bloku = celkový počet elementů. VCutWorks GUI čte toto pole. Writer psal vždy 1.
